sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'

SELECT `subscription_plan`.`plan_name`, COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_name` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`plan_name`
ORDER BY `paying_subscribers` DESC, `subscription_plan`.`plan_name` ASC

WITH region_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_customers`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `subscription`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
), ranked_regions AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `paying_customers`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `paying_customers` DESC) AS `region_rank`
  FROM region_counts
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `paying_customers`
FROM ranked_regions
WHERE `region_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `paying_customers` DESC, `region` ASC;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual' THEN try_divide(`subscription`.`base_rate_amount`,12) ELSE `subscription`.`base_rate_amount` END), 2) AS `mrr`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`payment`.`amount`), 2) AS `total_payments_received`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Succeeded'
  AND `payment`.`payment_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01'
  AND `payment`.`payment_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'

WITH `first_signup` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(`subscription`.`activation_date`) AS `signup_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  WHERE `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `signup_date`) AS `month`,
  COUNT(*) AS `new_signups`
FROM `first_signup`
WHERE `signup_date` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND `signup_date` < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `signup_date`)
ORDER BY `month` ASC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp`) AS `month`, COUNT(DISTINCT `churn_event`.`subscriber_id`) AS `churned_paid_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` IS NOT NULL
  AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp`)
ORDER BY `month`

SELECT
  `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `churn_reason`,
  COUNT(*) AS `churn_count`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
WHERE `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE'2026-11-09', -6)
  AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < DATE_ADD(DATE'2026-11-09', 1)
  AND `territory`.`territory_group` = 'LATAM'
  AND `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description`
ORDER BY `churn_count` DESC, `churn_reason` ASC

WITH method_stats AS (
  SELECT
    payment.method_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment.payment_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_payments,
    COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
    try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN payment.payment_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0, COUNT(*)) AS failure_rate_percent
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.payment
  WHERE payment.method_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY payment.method_type
), ranked_methods AS (
  SELECT
    method_stats.method_type,
    method_stats.failed_payments,
    method_stats.total_payments,
    method_stats.failure_rate_percent,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY method_stats.failed_payments DESC, method_stats.failure_rate_percent DESC) AS method_rank
  FROM method_stats
)
SELECT
  ranked_methods.method_type,
  ranked_methods.failed_payments,
  ranked_methods.total_payments,
  ROUND(ranked_methods.failure_rate_percent, 1) AS failure_rate_percent
FROM ranked_methods
WHERE ranked_methods.method_rank = 1
ORDER BY ranked_methods.failed_payments DESC, ranked_methods.failure_rate_percent DESC, ranked_methods.method_type

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`amount`), 2) AS `total_refunded_amount`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'
  AND `processing_date` >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10')
  AND `processing_date` < DATE'2026-11-10'

WITH `paid_subs` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription`.`subscription_type`,
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` IS NOT NULL
    AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` IN ('Annual', 'Monthly')
), `counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription_type`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
  FROM `paid_subs`
  GROUP BY `subscription_type`
), `total` AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`) AS `total_paying_subscribers`
  FROM `paid_subs`
)
SELECT
  `counts`.`subscription_type`,
  `counts`.`paying_subscribers`,
  try_divide(100.0 * `counts`.`paying_subscribers`,`total`.`total_paying_subscribers`) AS `percent_of_paying_subscribers`
FROM `counts`
CROSS JOIN `total`
ORDER BY `counts`.`paying_subscribers` DESC;

WITH `free_paid_dates` AS (
  SELECT
    `s`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(CASE WHEN `sp`.`plan_type` = 'Free' AND `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL THEN `s`.`activation_date` END) AS `first_free_activation_date`,
    MIN(CASE WHEN `sp`.`plan_type` = 'Paid' AND `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL THEN `s`.`activation_date` END) AS `first_paid_activation_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  GROUP BY `s`.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `subscribers_moved_from_free_to_paid`
FROM `free_paid_dates`
WHERE `first_free_activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `first_paid_activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `first_paid_activation_date` > `first_free_activation_date`

WITH `title_watch_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `title`.`title_id`,
    `title`.`name` AS `title_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  WHERE `title`.`title_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `title`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `title`.`title_id`, `title`.`name`
), `ranked_titles` AS (
  SELECT
    `title_id`,
    `title_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `watch_hours_rank`
  FROM `title_watch_hours`
)
SELECT
  `title_id`,
  `title_name`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_titles`
WHERE `watch_hours_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `title_id` ASC

WITH `genre_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre`.`genre_id`,
    `genre`.`name` AS `genre`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
    ON `title`.`series_id` = `series`.`series_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`genre` AS `genre`
    ON `series`.`genre_id` = `genre`.`genre_id`
  WHERE `genre`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `genre`.`genre_id`, `genre`.`name`
), `ranked_genres` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre_id`,
    `genre`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `genre_rank`
  FROM `genre_hours`
)
SELECT
  `genre_id`,
  `genre`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_genres`
WHERE `genre_rank` <= 5
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `genre_id` ASC

WITH `total_watch` AS (
  SELECT SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`) AS `total_watch_seconds`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
),
`moonlit_blade_watch` AS (
  SELECT SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`) AS `moonlit_blade_watch_seconds`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
    ON `title`.`series_id` = `series`.`series_id`
  WHERE `series`.`franchise_name` = 'Moonlit Blade'
)
SELECT
  try_divide(`moonlit_blade_watch`.`moonlit_blade_watch_seconds`,3600.0) AS `moonlit_blade_watch_hours`,
  try_divide(`total_watch`.`total_watch_seconds`,3600.0) AS `total_watch_hours`,
  100.0 * (try_divide(`moonlit_blade_watch`.`moonlit_blade_watch_seconds`,`total_watch`.`total_watch_seconds`)) AS `watch_time_share_percent`
FROM `moonlit_blade_watch`
CROSS JOIN `total_watch`

WITH watch_time AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN `title`.`is_simulcast` = true THEN 'Simulcast'
      ELSE 'Back catalog'
    END AS `content_bucket`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN `title`.`is_simulcast` = true THEN 'Simulcast'
      ELSE 'Back catalog'
    END
)
SELECT
  `content_bucket`,
  `watch_hours`,
  try_divide(`watch_hours`,SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER ()) * 100.0 AS `share_percent`
FROM `watch_time`
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC;

SELECT
  `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `playback_session`.`audio_language` <> 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `dubbed_sessions`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `playback_session`.`audio_language` = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `subbed_sessions`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `playback_session`.`audio_language` <> 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0,COUNT(*)) AS `dubbed_session_share_pct`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `playback_session`.`audio_language` = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0,COUNT(*)) AS `subbed_session_share_pct`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  ON `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
WHERE `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
  AND `playback_session`.`audio_language` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
ORDER BY `territory`.`territory_group`

WITH device_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    `platform_type`,
    COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `platform_type` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `platform_type`
), ranked_devices AS (
  SELECT
    `platform_type`,
    `sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `sessions` DESC) AS `device_rank`
  FROM device_sessions
)
SELECT
  `platform_type`,
  `sessions`,
  `device_rank`
FROM ranked_devices
ORDER BY `sessions` DESC, `platform_type` ASC

SELECT COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
  AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')

WITH monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `session_start_timestamp`) AS `month_start`,
    try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`,
    COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `session_start_timestamp` IS NOT NULL
    AND `session_start_timestamp` >= DATE'2026-01-01'
    AND `session_start_timestamp` < DATE'2027-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `session_start_timestamp`)
), ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    `month_start`,
    `watch_hours`,
    `sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `sessions` DESC) AS `month_rank`
  FROM monthly_activity
)
SELECT
  `month_start`,
  `watch_hours`,
  `sessions`
FROM ranked_months
WHERE `month_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `sessions` DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `session_start_timestamp`) AS `month`, try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `session_start_timestamp` IS NOT NULL
  AND `session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-01-01 00:00:00')
  AND `session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2027-01-01 00:00:00')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `session_start_timestamp`)
ORDER BY `month` ASC

SELECT
  `title`.`content_type`,
  COUNT(*) AS `titles`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
WHERE `title`.`content_type` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `title`.`content_type`
ORDER BY `titles` DESC, `title`.`content_type`

SELECT CASE WHEN `title`.`is_simulcast` = true THEN 'Simulcast' ELSE 'Non-simulcast' END AS `simulcast_status`, AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `average_completion_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
  ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
  ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
WHERE `title`.`is_simulcast` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CASE WHEN `title`.`is_simulcast` = true THEN 'Simulcast' ELSE 'Non-simulcast' END
ORDER BY `simulcast_status`

SELECT
  `playback_mode`,
  try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`,
  try_divide(100.0 * SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),SUM(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`)) OVER ()) AS `viewing_share_percent`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `playback_mode` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `playback_mode`
ORDER BY `viewing_share_percent` DESC

SELECT 100.0 * TRY_DIVIDE(
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= CAST(`content_episode`.`vod_available_from_date` AS TIMESTAMP)
         AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < dateadd(DAY, 7, CAST(`content_episode`.`vod_available_from_date` AS TIMESTAMP))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END),
  COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`)
) AS `simulcast_views_within_week_percent`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
  ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
  ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
WHERE `title`.`is_simulcast` = true
  AND `content_episode`.`vod_available_from_date` IS NOT NULL

SELECT h.holder_id, h.*, SUM(a.total_license_fee) AS fee, COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = a.primary_license_holder_id WHERE a.agreement_status = 'Active' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY fee DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT statement_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(net_royalty_amount) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN paid_timestamp IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid, SUM(CASE WHEN statement_due_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pastdue, MIN(statement_due_date) AS mn, MAX(statement_due_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT currency_code) AS c FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, COUNT(*) AS statements, SUM(r.net_royalty_amount) AS net_owed, SUM(r.gross_royalty_amount) AS gross, MIN(r.statement_due_date) AS oldest_due FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS r JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = r.holder_id WHERE r.statement_status = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY net_owed DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.territory_group, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN w.active_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_flag_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN w.availability_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_active, SUM(CASE WHEN w.active_flag AND w.availability_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN w.active_flag AND w.blackout_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_blackout FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON w.territory_id = t.territory_id GROUP BY t.territory_group ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1001
SELECT advertiser_id, legal_name, trade_name FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser WHERE legal_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' OR trade_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' LIMIT 1001

WITH v AS (SELECT s.territory_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS viewers, SUM(ps.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = ps.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ps.subscriber_id WHERE e.title_id IN (1, 669, 696) GROUP BY s.territory_id), w AS (SELECT territory_id, COUNT(*) AS windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag AND NOT blackout_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_nonblackout, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN active_flag THEN title_id END) AS active_titles FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id IN (1, 669, 696) GROUP BY territory_id) SELECT t.name, t.territory_group, v.sessions, v.viewers, ROUND(v.hours, 1) AS hours, COALESCE(w.windows, 0) AS windows, COALESCE(w.active_windows, 0) AS active_windows, COALESCE(w.active_nonblackout, 0) AS active_nonblackout, COALESCE(w.active_titles, 0) AS active_titles FROM v JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = v.territory_id LEFT JOIN w ON w.territory_id = v.territory_id ORDER BY active_windows, v.sessions DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_group AS region, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS s ON i.playback_session_id = s.playback_session_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS b ON s.subscriber_id = b.subscriber_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON b.territory_id = t.territory_id WHERE i.delivery_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001

WITH w AS (SELECT e.title_id, SUM(p.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS hrs, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id GROUP BY e.title_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hrs DESC) AS rk_h, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sessions DESC) AS rk_s FROM w), a AS (SELECT title_id, COUNT(*) AS n_windows, SUM(CASE WHEN active_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_active, SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_status_active FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window GROUP BY title_id) SELECT r.title_id, t.name, ROUND(hrs, 1) AS hrs, sessions, rk_h, rk_s, COALESCE(n_windows, 0) AS n_windows, COALESCE(n_active, 0) AS n_active, COALESCE(n_status_active, 0) AS n_status_active FROM r JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t USING (title_id) LEFT JOIN a USING (title_id) WHERE rk_h <= 20 OR rk_s <= 20 ORDER BY rk_h LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'

SELECT `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`, COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  ON `subscription`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
ORDER BY `paying_subscribers` DESC

WITH `paid_adds` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paid_adds`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `subscription`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `subscription`.`activation_date` >= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND `subscription`.`activation_date` < DATE '2026-11-01'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
),
`paid_churn` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `churn_event`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paid_churn`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
),
`regions` AS (
  SELECT `region` FROM `paid_adds`
  UNION
  SELECT `region` FROM `paid_churn`
)
SELECT
  `regions`.`region`,
  COALESCE(`paid_adds`.`paid_adds`, 0) AS `paid_adds`,
  COALESCE(`paid_churn`.`paid_churn`, 0) AS `paid_churn`,
  COALESCE(`paid_adds`.`paid_adds`, 0) - COALESCE(`paid_churn`.`paid_churn`, 0) AS `net_change_paid_subscribers`
FROM `regions`
LEFT JOIN `paid_adds`
  ON `regions`.`region` = `paid_adds`.`region`
LEFT JOIN `paid_churn`
  ON `regions`.`region` = `paid_churn`.`region`
WHERE `regions`.`region` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `net_change_paid_subscribers` ASC, `regions`.`region` ASC

WITH `title_watch_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `title`.`title_id`,
    `title`.`name` AS `title_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')
    AND `title`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `title`.`title_id`, `title`.`name`
), `ranked_titles` AS (
  SELECT
    `title_id`,
    `title_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `watch_hours_rank`
  FROM `title_watch_hours`
)
SELECT
  `title_id`,
  `title_name`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_titles`
WHERE `watch_hours_rank` <= 5
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `title_id` ASC;

WITH title_watch_hours AS (

    `title`.`title_id`,
    `title`.`name` AS `title_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`

  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`

    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00'
    AND `title`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `title`.`title_id`, `title`.`name`
), ranked_titles AS (
  SELECT
    `title_id`,
    `title_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `watch_hours_rank`

SELECT

    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
